description: This file contains generated source code defining serializers, coders, and copiers for Protobuf message types within the Orleans serialization framework. It includes classes for ByteString, MapField, RepeatedField, and a Protobuf general codec, along with their respective copiers and associated extension methods.

classes.name: ByteStringCodec
classes.description: Serializes and deserializes Google.Protobuf.ByteString data for Orleans serialization.

classes.name: ByteStringCopier
classes.description: Provides deep copying for Google.Protobuf.ByteString objects.

classes.name: MapFieldCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Serializes MapField data structures with specified key and value codecs.

classes.name: MapFieldCopier<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: Provides deep copying capabilities for MapField objects.

classes.name: ProtobufCodec
classes.description: A generalized serializer and copiers for protobuf types, supporting well-known aliasing and type filtering.

classes.name: RepeatedFieldCopier<T>
classes.description: Provides deep copying for RepeatedField objects.

classes.name: SerializationHostingExtensions
classes.description: Provides extension methods to add protobuf serializers to serializer builders.
